messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "dose may be increased to 20 mg once a day after at least 3 weeks of treatment if necessary"
set: ["dose may be increased to 20 mg once a day after at least 3 weeks of treatment if necessary", "20 mg once a day", "dose may be increased to 9 mg once daily", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "30 mg orally once a day for at least 2 weeks", "20 mg orally once a day", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "20 to 40 mg orally once a day", "10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "may be increased by 20 or 40 mg", "may be increased to 20 mg per day after one week if symptoms are not adequately controlled", "0.8 mg once a day if symptoms not improved after 2 to 4 weeks at 0.4 mg", "treatment should start at 0.4 mg once a day", "150 mg orally once a day for 3 days, increased to 150 mg orally twice a day", "dose may be gradually increased", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
